python3 -c "
import subprocess, json, os
cwd = os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR', '.')
branch = subprocess.run(['git','branch','--show-current'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd).stdout.strip()
status = subprocess.run(['git','status','--short'], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=cwd).stdout.strip()
ctx = f'Git branch: {branch}' + (f'. Uncommitted changes:\n{status}' if status else '. Working tree clean.')
print(json.dumps({'additionalContext': ctx}))
" 2>/dev/null || echo '{}'
